limits: This reaches a finite fixed point only for exact GPR taint states generated by the current transfer semantics and resolved direct CFG successors.
Stack/memory taint is not carried across CFG edges; aliases, call returns, unresolved indirect successors, richer value transforms and runtime/heap mutation remain open.
No predecessor union/phi abstraction is performed; equivalent exact states are deduplicated, so this does not prove arbitrary semantic phi reconstruction.
next_step: Carry exact stack cells across CFG edges, then compose GPR+stack fixed-point reachability before addressing writable aliases and runtime mutation.

scope.carried_state: GPR provenance only using upstream bounded copy/transform transfer semantics
scope.join_model: no taint union or predecessor merge; identical exact states are deduplicated, yielding finite cycle-aware reachability
scope.state_key: instruction index plus exact GPR taint/transformed boolean mapping
scope.successor_model: all resolved direct jump/conditional taken and fallthrough successors; indirect successors never guessed
